title: Mimas item
description: One piece of gear (items/*.json). A hero is rules.baseStats plus four of these.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the id.

slot.description: One item per slot, all four mandatory on a hero.

kind.description: Family the boons match on: bow, gun, circlet, leaping, blink, leather, ...

icon.description: Presentation key resolved to a sprite by the client.

stats.description: Added to rules.baseStats. Never negative; a lane key must name a declared lane.

abilities.description: Ability ids this item grants, in HUD order. A weapon needs at least one attack; no id may repeat rules.innateAbilities.
